summary: Enable HMAC-signed per-request audit headers + near-real-time SIEM alert handoff for NimbusBank
description: NimbusBank (enterprise) requests a near-real-time SIEM handoff that includes HMAC-signed per-request audit headers and an ordered delivery guarantee. They want per-event non-repudiation (HMAC or ed25519), a resume token for replaying missed events, and evidence that delivery and ordering are preserved. Customer provided a sample webhook payload and a security questionnaire that requires cryptographic receipts and delivery acknowledgements.
impact: Customer cannot complete security onboarding. Their SOC team will not accept the Redwood webhook feed without signed per-event attestations and a deterministic ordering guarantee. This blocks production go-live for several high-value workloads.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer configures a live webhook endpoint in Console -> Integrations -> Webhooks with topic 'audit.events'
2) Customer sends test events via the API (sample payload attached by customer)
3) Customer observes that headers currently include X-Redwood-Request-Id and X-Redwood-Timestamp but no signature/HMAC header
4) Customer expects 'X-Redwood-Signature' and 'X-Redwood-Resume-Token' on the webhook POST and a 2xx ack with a delivery receipt returned to Redwood's console
5) Customer notes occasional out-of-order events during small bursts in us-east-1 and sees gaps in resume tokens when replaying using current API
logs: Customer provided webhook request/response logs (attached). Sample excerpt: 'POST /webhook 200 - headers: {X-Redwood-Request-Id: r-0a1b2c3, X-Redwood-Timestamp: 2026-03-12T18:22:03Z} body: {event_id: "evt-9f3", tenant: "nimbusbank", ...}'; no signature header present. Console shows 'webhook delivery: succeeded' but customer reports missing evidence for SOC intake.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-13 09:12 - Ava M: Confirmed customer sample and repro steps. No signature header is currently emitted by the webhook delivery pipeline.

2026-03-13 11:40 - Diego R (SRE): Observed that the delivery pipeline attaches request-id/timestamp but signing hook was removed during an earlier refactor to reduce latency in 2025-11. Need to reintroduce signing as an opt-in feature.
2026-03-13 14:05 - Security (Leila Q): Prefers HMAC with rotating KEKs for per-tenant key isolation. Ed25519 acceptable if we provide key attestation document and rotation schedule.

2026-03-14 08:30 - Product (Mina K): Customer expects ordering guarantee: will implement an ordered-seq header and resume-token that is monotonically increasing per-tenant and include a signed checkpoint manifest for daily batches.
Observed intermittent reordering source: small parallel workers in webhook shuffler; plan to add per-tenant single-writer queue for ordering and attach resume token at commit time.
comments: 2026-03-13 09:20 - NimbusBank (Sarah T, SOC): 'We need cryptographic proof of delivery to match our SIEM ingestion rules. HMAC with per-tenant key rotation is ideal. Can you provide an integration timeline?'
2026-03-13 11:55 - Ava M (Support): 'Acknowledged, we are triaging. SRE and Security looped in. We will propose an implementation plan by EOD 2026-03-14.'

2026-03-14 10:02 - Diego R (SRE): 'Initial patch to reintroduce signing is scoped. Will create a PR to add X-Redwood-Signature (hmac-sha256) and X-Redwood-Resume-Token. Need security review for rotation cadence.'
2026-03-14 12:45 - Leila Q (Security): 'Approve HMAC-SHA256 with per-tenant KEK rotated monthly and HKDF-derived per-event key. Document requirements for key rollover and proof-of-previous-keys.'
resolution: Triage complete; implementation plan approved. Next steps: (1) create PR to add 'X-Redwood-Signature' HMAC-SHA256 header and 'X-Redwood-Resume-Token' (Diego), (2) add tenant single-writer queue to preserve ordering (Diego), (3) security will publish key-rotation/attestation doc and sample verification scripts (Leila). No customer-facing patch yet; ETA ~5 business days for a staged rollout to prod us-east-1.
